summary.en: Web console for a Temporal server: workflows, namespaces, schedules.
For the PHP extensions this app already offers. sqlsrv and pdo_sqlsrv have been in the extension list all along with nothing in the catalogue to connect them to.
summary.tr: Bu uygulamanın zaten sunduğu PHP uzantıları için. sqlsrv ve pdo_sqlsrv başından beri uzantı listesinde, ve bağlanacak hiçbir servis yoktu.

summary.en: Open-source Vault fork in dev mode (in-memory, auto-unsealed) for local integration work.
Durable workflow engine for local development; pair it with Temporal UI.
Open-source feature flag server with its own PostgreSQL.
Secrets manager in dev mode (in-memory, auto-unsealed) for local integration work.
Identity provider (OIDC, SAML, passkeys) with its own PostgreSQL.
Log aggregation that Grafana queries, single-binary with filesystem storage and OTLP ingestion.
Contrib distribution that receives OTLP and forwards traces to Tempo, logs to Loki and exposes metrics for Prometheus.
Trace storage that Grafana queries, single-binary with filesystem storage and OTLP ingestion.
One of the five queue drivers Laravel ships with. A project writing QUEUE_CONNECTION=beanstalkd had nothing here to point it at.
summary.tr: Laravel'in kutudan gelen beş kuyruk sürücüsünden biri. QUEUE_CONNECTION=beanstalkd yazan bir projenin burada gösterecek hiçbir şeyi yoktu.

summary.en: Elasticsearch-compatible search and analytics engine, security plugin off for local development.
Browser UI for exploring and visualising data in a StackVo OpenSearch instance.
